result.instructions: Tools for LimoExpress, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which bookings have a pickup tomorrow, and which of them are not confirmed yet?"; "List the unpaid invoices and the client for each one."; "What is the price for a trip from the airport to the city centre in an executive van?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes LimoExpress data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run limoexpress_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run limoexpress_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run limoexpress_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. limoexpress_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: limoexpress_mark_invoice_as_paid
